dynamicResearch.question: Can a governance-oriented geospatial world model improve territorial planning decisions by coupling hierarchical GIS state, policy constraints, evidence provenance, and action-conditioned forecasts in one auditable loop?
dynamicResearch.coreStateClaim: TWM represents parcels, projects, control boundaries, planning zones, approvals, evidence, and rules as a linked state rather than a flat feature table.
dynamicResearch.coreDynamicsClaim: For review, protection, conversion, and restoration actions, TWM forecasts a multidimensional hierarchical future-state representation, constraint risk, planning utility, uncertainty, and action feasibility. The representation is decoded into state summaries and does not generate full parcel geometry.
dynamicResearch.coreEvidenceName: Evidence-gated and causally calibrated claim ladder
dynamicResearch.coreEvidenceClaim: TWM separates deterministic rule evidence, observational causal calibration, and validation gates before upgrading any operational claim.
dynamicResearch.innovationArchitecture: The novelty is architectural integration, not that GIS simulation itself is new.
dynamicResearch.innovationArchitectureTest: Compare with land-use simulators, GIS rule engines, and optimization tools on whether they jointly expose action-conditioned forecasts, policy evidence, and audit-ready claim boundaries.
dynamicResearch.innovationConflict: Object-relation-rule-evidence state reduces missed compliance conflicts compared with layer-by-layer manual review.
dynamicResearch.innovationConflictTest: Measure hard-constraint conflict recall and false review burden on held-out real approval and review cases.
dynamicResearch.innovationDefensibility: Evidence-gated forecasts improve decision defensibility compared with black-box planning scores.
dynamicResearch.innovationDefensibilityTest: Audit whether every recommended or rejected option carries source evidence, a rule clause, uncertainty, and a human-review reason.
dynamicResearch.unmetFragmented: Planning and land-use review workflows still fragment spatial overlays, policy checks, approval evidence, and scenario comparison across separate tools.
dynamicResearch.unmetSimulation: Existing land-use simulators emphasize spatial pattern transition, while operational review needs action consequences, rule validity, and audit boundaries.
dynamicResearch.unmetOptimization: Optimization tools can rank candidates, but often do not preserve why a candidate is illegal, under-evidenced, or reviewable rather than approvable.
dynamicResearch.falsificationSolved: If real workflow interviews show the target decisions are already well solved by existing tools, TWM should be narrowed or stopped.
dynamicResearch.falsificationNoLift: If TWM does not improve hard-constraint conflict recall, evidence completeness, or audit-trail quality over baselines, the claimed contribution is not supported.
dynamicResearch.falsificationSynthetic: If action-conditioned dynamics cannot be validated beyond synthetic fixtures, TWM must remain a review scaffold rather than a production decision model.
dynamicResearch.claimBoundary: Current TWM is a rigorous prototype and review scaffold. Its defensible near-term claim is auditable decision support for territorial governance workflows; production-grade predictive claims require real observed histories, baseline comparisons, and external validation.

dynamicDataFoundation.mentorShort: The reliable part of TWM today is engineering and research-hypothesis validation, not proof of production deployment. Without real approval history and policy-action labels, it cannot claim to have solved real territorial-governance decisions.

spatialScope.finalWarning: UWM can reuse these identities for renderer alignment and state indexing, but Kernel propagation still requires an independently validated adjacency graph.

crossDomain.title: Cross-domain impact evidence and priority (requirement 24)
crossDomain.warning: Priority represents evidence orchestration and dependency readiness only; it is not problem severity, policy benefit, or investment return. Spatial grains are not forcibly merged.

resilience.title: Resilience world model (requirement 19)
resilience.warning: Spatial adjacency is not a hazard-propagation coefficient; facility presence is not emergency-response capacity. Dynamic rollout opens only when hazard, exposure, propagation, recovery, intervention, and evaluation evidence gates are satisfied.

publicSpace.title: Public space and place-making (Demand 9)
publicSpace.subtitle: Current output covers the inventory, strict categories, district distribution, and relative_public_space_evidence_gap; no composite public-space quality or vitality score is generated.
publicSpace.warning: Landscape quality, street vitality, actual use, shade, seating, street furniture, waterfront access, safety, and accessibility data are not ready.

mobility.title: Demand 8 · Mobility, walkability, and accessibility
mobility.subtitle: This product diagnoses current conditions with service-facility and road-network proxies. network_proxy_not_observed_walk_time=true; evidence channels remain separate and are not combined into one score.
mobility.warning: public_transport / road_safety / shaded_routes / universal_accessibility / parking_pressure / cycling_routes / pedestrian_crossings are currently unavailable.
mobility.footer: implemented means an existing data product; proxy_only means a network or distance proxy; unavailable means no supportable value is currently available. Ranking is for data review and planning review only.

socialService.title: Facilities and public-service evidence products
socialService.subtitle: Current output is an observed-facility inventory and relative_evidence_gap; static facility statistics are not presented as UWM.
socialService.warning: Capacity, lifecycle, active state, population-capacity matching, authoritative service areas, and future demand data are not ready. Township accessibility is not force-linked to district facilities.

actions.sendToMap: Send current facility view to map

dailyConvenience.title: Daily convenience and business-activity evidence (Demand 14)
dailyConvenience.warning: POI presence does not mean the business is operating; business POIs do not represent jobs; a relative gap is not an authoritative market shortage.
dailyConvenience.finalWarning: Operating status, licenses, employment, income, transactions, footfall, market demand, entrepreneurship opportunities, and economic activation effects are not ready.

actions.sendToMap: Send current evidence view to map

housing.title: Housing and community-composition evidence (Demand 13)
housing.warning: Building counts are not dwelling counts; floor proxies are not residential area; downscaled population is not census microdata; a relative evidence gap is not a housing shortage.
housing.finalWarning: Housing types, units, residential area, vacancy, prices and rents, affordability, tenure, household composition, crowding, jobs-housing proximity, mixed use, and policy-causal effects are not ready.

actions.sendToMap: Send current evidence view to map

safety.title: Safety and comfort evidence diagnosis (Demand 10)
safety.warning: Evidence-gap ranking is not danger severity; temperature context is not thermal comfort; road context is not road safety.
safety.referenceOnly: Environment and fire-facility data are currently reference_only and are not joined by name or centroid.
safety.finalWarning: Accidents, crime, lighting, crossings, shade, accessibility, thermal comfort, emergency response, safe routes, and intervention effects are not ready.

territoryWorldModelDynamicRuntimeExtras.mentorAnswer: TWM's novelty cannot be established by listing model components. Every claim must be tied to a real business problem, a simple baseline, a data gate, and falsifiable metrics. Without production history and baseline comparisons, TWM may claim only an engineering prototype and review scaffold, not a production-grade world model.
territoryWorldModelDynamicRuntimeExtras.dataPackageBoundary: This data package is for testing and adaptation validation. When not_for_production=true, it must not support real governance conclusions.
territoryWorldModelDynamicRuntimeExtras.supportMaterialTerminology: The interface and reports use 'supporting material' or 'decision evidence'; backward-compatible backend fields may still use evidence.
territoryWorldModelDynamicRuntimeExtras.simulatorTerminology: State + action -> next-state summary, constraint risk, benefit, and confidence.
territoryWorldModelDynamicRuntimeExtras.plannerTerminology: Choose the next step from simulator-evaluated actions or candidates using constraints, benefit, risk, and supporting-material completeness.

territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c1CaseIdDescription: Stable sanitized same-case ID; it must match between TWM and the baseline.

territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c1TruthDescription: Ground-truth hard-constraint conflict confirmed by final disposition, review conclusion, or expert relabeling.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c1TruthSanitization: Keep only the Boolean label; do not export sensitive source text.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c1DetectedDescription: Whether TWM or the manual-overlay checklist detected the conflict during review.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c1EvidenceDescription: Whether the result is traceable to a layer version, rule clause, screenshot, or review evidence.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c1EvidenceSanitization: The evidence link must reference an internal sanitized index; do not export raw file paths.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c1UnsupportedDescription: Whether the system still recommends proceeding when evidence is insufficient or a hard constraint remains unresolved.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c1UnsupportedSanitization: Keep only the Boolean label and a sanitized reason.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c1RecallSupports: TWM recall on the same cases exceeds the manual baseline and meets the claim threshold.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c1MissedSupports: TWM's miss rate is lower than the manual baseline and below the permitted ceiling.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c1EvidenceSupports: Risks reported by TWM consistently link to evidence and rule versions.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c1CollectSource: Extract project geometry, authoritative boundary versions, final dispositions, and manual-overlay checklist results from the same historical projects.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c1CollectTruth: Have operators or reviewers establish ground_truth_conflict first, then export TWM and manual-baseline detections separately.

territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c1CollectValidate: Run baseline_export_validation_report first, then baseline_evidence_pipeline_report after it passes.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c2CaseIdSanitization: Use irreversible anonymization and keep the same case consistent across both CSV files.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c2EvidenceDescription: Whether a rule hit is traceable to an evidence package, layer version, and clause.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c2EvidenceSanitization: Export only evidence_uri or an evidence index; do not export original sensitive attachments.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c2UnsupportedDescription: Whether the output still recommends approval or proceeding when evidence is missing, a hard constraint exists, or human review is required.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c2UnsupportedSanitization: Export only the Boolean value and a sanitized disposition category.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c2ReviewTaskDescription: Whether the system creates or recommends a human review task.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c2ReviewConfirmedDescription: Whether business staff confirmed that the review task was necessary.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c2ReviewConfirmedSanitization: Export only the confirmation result, not staff names.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c2AuditSupports: TWM evidence-chain completeness exceeds the rule-only baseline.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c2SafetySupports: TWM recommends proceeding less often when evidence is insufficient.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c2ReviewPrecisionSupports: Review tasks triggered by TWM more closely match reviews confirmed as necessary by business staff.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c2CollectRun: Lock the same review cases and rule version, then run the TWM evidence gate and rule-only baseline separately.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c2CollectConfirm: Have business reviewers confirm review_task_true_positive and audit_reviewer_disposition.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c2CollectEvidence: Ensure evidence_uri references an auditable, sanitized evidence index.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c2CollectValidate: Pass export validation before submitting complete metrics to baseline comparison.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c3CandidateIdDescription: Sanitized candidate-plan ID; it must match between TWM and the baseline.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c3CandidateIdSanitization: Use irreversible anonymization while preserving cross-system consistency for the same candidate.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c3RankDescription: Candidate-plan rank; a smaller number means higher priority.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c3RankSanitization: Do not include real parcel or party names.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c3SelectedDescription: Whether the candidate enters the recommended or Top-K set.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c3LegalDescription: Whether the candidate is legally feasible under the current hard constraints and evidence.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c3LegalSanitization: Export only the Boolean label and a sanitized reason.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c3RegretDescription: Utility loss relative to a human or expert oracle.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c3RegretSanitization: Export a normalized difference, not sensitive benefit-calculation details.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c3RejectionDescription: Sanitized reason for an illegal, under-evidenced, or review-only result.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c3RejectionSanitization: Use a standard reason enum; do not export full original review opinions.

territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c3LegalSupports: The legally feasible share of TWM's recommendation set exceeds the optimization-only baseline.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c3RegretSupports: TWM has lower average regret relative to the human oracle.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c3CollectCandidates: Preserve a stable candidate_id for the same candidates and record action_type, rank, recommendation set, and human or expert oracle.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c3CollectRun: Using the same rule version and evidence snapshot, run TWM action-conditioned triage and the simulation or optimization-only baseline separately.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c3CollectNormalize: Normalize illegal, under-evidenced, and review-only reasons to a standard enum to avoid exporting sensitive original review text.
territoryWorldModelDynamicBaselineDetail.c3CollectValidate: Confirm candidate_id overlap before comparing Top-K precision, reason coverage, and regret.

terminology.body: The former 30 labels were internal compute partitions, not official drainage districts and not the source of citywide results. Map results use customer node and pipe geometry; internal partitions are only for diagnostics and scheduling.

scenario.title: Scenario inputs
scenario.disclaimer: Run invokes EPA SWMM 5.2.4 on the continuous citywide network and stores native RPT / OUT. Design storms use the 2022 official Zone B DDF values for 2/5/10/25/50/100-year return periods at 180 minutes. The DDF does not publish a complete hyetograph; 5-minute alternating-block allocation and a 40% peak position are explicit modeling assumptions. Results are not calibrated or engineering-admitted.
